statement: The FOMC raises the federal funds target range by 25 basis points to 3.75-4.00 percent at its meeting concluding 2026-09-16. Reference: 3.50-3.75 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if the FOMC statement dated 2026-09-16 on federalreserve.gov sets the federal funds target range at 3.75 to 4.00 percent. Any other range, including a larger hike or a hold, is false.
failure_condition: The federal funds target range set at the 2026-09-16 FOMC decision is anything other than 3.75 to 4.00 percent.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield for the observation date 2026-10-30 is at or above 5.00 percent. Reference: 4.94 percent on the packet date.
resolution: True if FRED series DGS10 shows a value of 5.00 or higher for the observation date 2026-10-30; false if the value is below 5.00.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield for 2026-10-30 is below 5.00 percent.

statement: The EIA weekly U.S. No. 2 on-highway diesel retail price for the week of 2026-10-26 is at or above 6.000 dollars per gallon. Reference: 5.967 for the week of 2026-09-07, the latest EIA print at seal.
resolution: True if EIA series EMD_EPD2D_PTE_NUS_DPG reports 6.000 dollars per gallon or higher for the week of 2026-10-26; false if lower.
failure_condition: The EIA US average diesel retail price for the week of 2026-10-26 is below 6.000 dollars per gallon.

statement: A merchant vessel is struck by a missile, drone, projectile, or explosive boat in the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandab, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11.
resolution: True if UKMTO or JMIC publishes an incident report of a merchant vessel struck by a missile, drone, projectile, or explosive boat in those waters, occurring between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is struck by a missile, drone, projectile, or explosive boat in the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandab, or Gulf of Aden between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-11.

statement: The United States and Iran each publicly accept a mutual ceasefire or cessation of hostilities announced between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: True if, between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-31, both the US government and the Iranian government publicly confirm a mutual ceasefire, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, and AFP.
failure_condition: No mutual ceasefire or cessation of hostilities is agreed and publicly confirmed by both the US and Iranian governments between 2026-09-12 and 2026-10-31.

statement: CISA adds GitLab CVE-2026-85706 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-13. Not listed in KEV catalog version 2026.09.10 at seal.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV catalog JSON lists CVE-2026-85706 with a dateAdded value from 2026-09-11 through 2026-11-13; false otherwise.
failure_condition: CISA does not add CVE-2026-85706 to the KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-09-11 and 2026-11-13.

statement: CISA sets knownRansomwareCampaignUse to Known for PaperCut CVE-2026-82078 or CVE-2026-81578 between 2026-09-11 and 2026-12-11. Reference: both Unknown in KEV catalog version 2026.09.10 at seal.
resolution: True if the latest CISA KEV catalog version released between 2026-09-11 and 2026-12-11 shows knownRansomwareCampaignUse Known for CVE-2026-82078 or CVE-2026-81578; false if both remain Unknown.
failure_condition: Both CVE-2026-82078 and CVE-2026-81578 carry knownRansomwareCampaignUse Unknown in the latest KEV catalog version released on or before 2026-12-11.

statement: Zack Polanski of the Green Party wins the Holborn and St Pancras parliamentary by-election polled on 2026-10-08.
resolution: True if the returning officer declaration for the Holborn and St Pancras by-election polled on 2026-10-08 names Zack Polanski as elected; false if another candidate is declared or no result is declared by 2026-10-10.
failure_condition: A candidate other than Zack Polanski is declared elected in the Holborn and St Pancras by-election polled on 2026-10-08.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of 435 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election.
resolution: True if Associated Press race calls made by 2026-11-23 credit Democrats with 218 or more House seats from the 2026-11-03 election; false otherwise.
failure_condition: Democrats win fewer than 218 House seats in the 2026-11-03 election, or their 218th seat remains undecided on 2026-11-23.

statement: A laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease case is diagnosed in a country other than the DRC between 2026-09-12 and 2026-11-13, excluding planned medical evacuations.
resolution: True if a WHO Disease Outbreak News item or a national health ministry reports a laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo case diagnosed outside the DRC, not a planned medical evacuation, between 2026-09-12 and 2026-11-13.
failure_condition: No laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo virus case, other than a planned medical evacuation, is diagnosed in any country outside the DRC between 2026-09-12 and 2026-11-13.
